title: Young guns take charge
desc: The appointment of relatively young civil servants, with many years left in public service, to top bureaucratic posts under Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has drawn attention in political and administrative circles.
title_cn: 年轻官员崭露头角 泰国官场面临新格局
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷·查尔维拉库尔(Anutin Charnvirakul)任期内，一批相对年轻的公务员被任命到关键行政高位。这些年轻官员仍有数十年职业生涯，其大规模晋升在政治和官僚系统内引发关注和讨论。
desc_original: The appointment of relatively young civil servants, with many years left in public service, to top bureaucratic posts under Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has drawn attention in political and administrative circles.

title: Rajavithi opens sexual health clinic
desc: Rajavithi Hospital has opened a sexual health clinic offering consultations and treatment for sexual health problems, gender-affirming care and HPV-related services.
title_cn: 拉查维蒂医院 Rajavithi 开设性健康诊所
summary_cn: 曼谷拉查维蒂医院 Rajavithi Hospital 新开性健康诊所，提供性健康问题咨询与治疗、性别认同相关的医疗服务，以及人乳头瘤病毒 HPV 相关检验与治疗。这是医院深化多元包容医疗、扩展性健康专科的举措。
desc_original: Rajavithi Hospital has opened a sexual health clinic offering consultations and treatment for sexual health problems, gender-affirming care and HPV-related services.

title: PM orders probe into copter shooting claim
desc: Prime Minister and Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered an investigation into allegations that security personnel fired on civilians from a helicopter during recent unrest in the southernmost provinces, despite a firm denial from the Fourth Army Region commander.
title_cn: 总理下令调查直升机射击指控
summary_cn: 总理兼内政部长阿努廷 Anutin Charnvirakul 下令调查关于安保人员在南方三府最近动乱期间从直升机向民众射击的指控。第四陆军区司令已强硬否认此事。安全部队向民众开火属极端指控，涉及民众人身安全与部队纪律问责。
desc_original: Prime Minister and Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered an investigation into allegations that security personnel fired on civilians from a helicopter during recent unrest in the southernmost provinces, despite a firm denial from the Fourth Army Region commander.

title: Call for clear details on SIM registration
desc: The National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) is urging telecom operators to give customers clear explanations on how to update their information by Aug 31 to avoid difficulties making outgoing calls.
title_cn: 呼吁澄清 SIM 卡注册细节
summary_cn: 泰国通信委员会 NBTC 促请电信运营商向客户清楚说明如何在 8 月 31 日前更新 SIM 卡注册信息，否则用户可能面临无法拨打电话的困难。这涉及泰国全民手机实名制的执行，影响所有持机人通信权益。
desc_original: The National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) is urging telecom operators to give customers clear explanations on how to update their information by Aug 31 to avoid difficulties making outgoing calls.

title: Executive overhaul in the pipeline
desc: The cabinet has given the nod to a major reshuffle of 20 senior officials under the Interior Ministry, in what is seen as the biggest personnel overhaul since the Anutin Charnvirakul administration returned to office for its second term.
title_cn: 政府高管大规模改组即将启动
summary_cn: 内阁已批准内政部下属 20 名高级官员的重大改组，这是总理阿努廷 Anutin Charnvirakul 政府第二任期以来规模最大的人事调整。该改组将重新配置内政系统权力结构，涉及地方行政、治安与公务员体系，标志政府权力整合。
desc_original: The cabinet has given the nod to a major reshuffle of 20 senior officials under the Interior Ministry, in what is seen as the biggest personnel overhaul since the Anutin Charnvirakul administration returned to office for its second term.

title: Foreigners given a say on tourism fee
desc: The government is conducting an online public hearing for both Thais and foreigners on the proposed 450-baht tourism fee for foreign tourists and the fund's budget usage, insisting the procedures must be transparent and open to assessment.
title_cn: 外国人获邀对旅游费政策表态
summary_cn: 泰国政府就拟议的 450 泰铢外国游客旅游费及基金预算使用进行在线听证会，邀请泰国人与外国人参与，强调程序应透明接受评估。这一政策将直接影响赴泰旅游的成本与体验，关乎在泰外籍人士的旅游支出。
desc_original: The government is conducting an online public hearing for both Thais and foreigners on the proposed 450-baht tourism fee for foreign tourists and the fund's budget usage, insisting the procedures must be transparent and open to assessment.

title: Early retirement guidelines for civil servants take shape
desc: Guidelines for an early retirement scheme for civil servants are expected to be finalised tomorrow before they are submitted to the cabinet, as the government pushes ahead with its broader reform of the public-sector workforce.
title_cn: 公务员提前退休指南成形
summary_cn: 泰国政府推进公共部门改革，公务员提前退休方案指南预计明日定稿后提交内阁审议。此举为政府公务员制度改革的重要步骤，旨在优化公务员队伍结构，推动公共部门现代化建设。
desc_original: Guidelines for an early retirement scheme for civil servants are expected to be finalised tomorrow before they are submitted to the cabinet, as the government pushes ahead with its broader reform of the public-sector workforce.

title: Nan's floods: Turning water into wisdom
desc: For those of us who know Thailand, Nan is more than a province on the map. Its mountains, forests, farms and rivers are part of the natural heritage of our country. When Nan floods, we should see not only the immediate suffering of its people, but also a warning about how Thailand must prepare for a future in which extreme weather may become more disruptive.
title_cn: 南府洪灾：化危机为警示
summary_cn: 南府作为泰国重要的自然遗产，其山林、农田和河流系统的洪灾反映出泰国面临的极端天气挑战。此次灾情不仅造成当地民众直接苦难，更是泰国全国应为未来极端气候事件做好应对准备的警告信号，涉及国家长期防灾规划。
desc_original: For those of us who know Thailand, Nan is more than a province on the map. Its mountains, forests, farms and rivers are part of the natural heritage of our country. When Nan floods, we should see not only the immediate suffering of its people, but also a warning about how Thailand must prepare for a future in which extreme weather may become more disruptive.

title: รอบรั้วการตลาด : มาสเตอร์ แปลน 101 ส่งแบบบ้าน MTP HI ลุยงานรับสร้างบ้าน Expo 2026
desc: มาสเตอร์ แปลน 101 ตอกย้ำผู้นำธุรกิจรับสร้างบ้านหรู เผยพอร์ตงานในมือกว่า 1,400 ล้านบาท มั่นใจปีนี้เติบโตต่อเนื่อง 15%
title_cn: Master Plan 101 推出 MTP HI 房型，布局 Expo 2026 建筑项目
summary_cn: 豪华建筑商 Master Plan 101 日前强调其市场领先地位，披露当前项目储备约14亿泰铢。公司对今年增长15%持乐观预期，积极参与 Expo 2026 相关建设工程，推出 MTP HI 户型产品应对市场需求。
desc_original: มาสเตอร์ แปลน 101 ตอกย้ำผู้นำธุรกิจรับสร้างบ้านหรู เผยพอร์ตงานในมือกว่า 1,400 ล้านบาท มั่นใจปีนี้เติบโตต่อเนื่อง 15%

title: Industry sounds alarm on pickup sales
desc: The Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) is warning the continued decline in domestic pickup sales will result in severe repercussions for supply chains, auto parts suppliers and employment.
title_cn: 皮卡销售持续下滑，产业敲响警钟
summary_cn: 泰国工业联合会（FTI）发出预警，国内皮卡销售的持续下降将对汽车产业供应链、零部件供应商和就业市场造成严重负面冲击。这一警告反映了泰国汽车工业面临的市场挑战，产业界呼吁政府重视相关经济影响。
desc_original: The Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) is warning the continued decline in domestic pickup sales will result in severe repercussions for supply chains, auto parts suppliers and employment.

title: 2 ex-DLA chiefs in crosshairs
desc: The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) has confirmed that two former director-generals of the Department of Local Administration (DLA) are implicated in alleged cheating in the 2025 local government recruitment examination.
title_cn: 两名前地方行政部长官陷腐败指控
summary_cn: 国家反腐委员会（NACC）确认，两名地方行政部（DLA）前总长涉嫌在2025年地方政府招聘考试中存在舞弊行为，目前正成为反腐调查焦点。此案表明泰国反腐工作范围正向公务员选拔系统深入，体现政府加强廉政建设的决心。
desc_original: The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) has confirmed that two former director-generals of the Department of Local Administration (DLA) are implicated in alleged cheating in the 2025 local government recruitment examination.

title: Thailand maintains pole position in Southeast Asia
desc: Thailand's capital market maintained its leading position in Southeast Asia in terms of both average daily trading value and market capitalisation, while mutual fund assets continued to expand, reaching 6.3 trillion baht at the end of June, says the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
title_cn: 泰国保持东南亚资本市场领先地位
summary_cn: 根据泰国证券交易委员会（SEC）数据，泰国资本市场在日均交易额和市值方面继续保持东南亚领先位置。到6月末，泰国共同基金资产规模增长至6.3万亿泰铢，显示金融市场持续健康扩张的势头。
desc_original: Thailand's capital market maintained its leading position in Southeast Asia in terms of both average daily trading value and market capitalisation, while mutual fund assets continued to expand, reaching 6.3 trillion baht at the end of June, says the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).

title: Ratch preps power site for data centres
desc: Ratch Group, a power developer and subsidiary of the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (Egat), is embarking on a major transformation of its flagship Ratchaburi power plant site, aiming to repurpose the facility into a high-tech hub for data centres and next-generation industries.
title_cn: 拉查武里发电集团改造电厂建设数据中心
summary_cn: 泰国电力公司（EGAT）旗下的拉查武里发电集团（Ratch Group）启动其旗舰电厂的重大改造项目。该项目计划将现有电厂转变为高科技数据中心和下一代产业枢纽，充分利用现有的电力基础设施，推动产业升级。
desc_original: Ratch Group, a power developer and subsidiary of the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (Egat), is embarking on a major transformation of its flagship Ratchaburi power plant site, aiming to repurpose the facility into a high-tech hub for data centres and next-generation industries.

title: Fitch keeps ttb ratings steady following ING stake sale
desc: Fitch Ratings Thailand has affirmed TMBThanachart Bank's (ttb) subordinated debt rating at its current level, despite the sale of shares by a major shareholder.
title_cn: 国际评级机构确认泰民银行评级维持不变
summary_cn: 国际评级机构惠誉（Fitch）已确认泰民银行（TMBThanachart Bank，ttb）的次级债券评级保持现有水平，尽管该行主要股东进行了减持操作。这表明银行的信用状况依然稳健。
desc_original: Fitch Ratings Thailand has affirmed TMBThanachart Bank's (ttb) subordinated debt rating at its current level, despite the sale of shares by a major shareholder.

title: Flood relief budget set at B559m
desc: The cabinet has approved a central budget of 558.7 million baht to provide relief to those affected by flooding during this year's rainy season.
title_cn: 政府批准5.59亿泰铢用于防洪救灾
summary_cn: 泰国内阁已批准5.587亿泰铢的中央预算，专款用于救援今年雨季洪涝灾害的受灾民众。这笔资金将直接用于灾区救援、灾民补助和灾后重建，帮助受洪水影响的群众渡过难关。
desc_original: The cabinet has approved a central budget of 558.7 million baht to provide relief to those affected by flooding during this year's rainy season.

title: Cash mules held after drug probe
desc: Three people have been arrested after a Bangkok police investigation into online drug activity uncovered a scam network allegedly using cash mules to move money and fund drug purchases.
title_cn: 曼谷警方破获贩毒资金网络逮捕三名「金钱骡」
summary_cn: 曼谷警方在查处在线毒品犯罪的调查中，破获一个利用「金钱骡」（资金转移人员）进行洗钱、融资购毒的诈骗网络。警方已逮捕三名涉案人员，此案涉及毒品犯罪和金融欺诈，目前仍在进一步调查中。
desc_original: Three people have been arrested after a Bangkok police investigation into online drug activity uncovered a scam network allegedly using cash mules to move money and fund drug purchases.

title: Synnex, AWS see B1.2tn opportunity in AI sector
desc: Thailand could unlock up to 1.2 trillion baht in economic impact from artificial intelligence (AI) innovation, but businesses need to move beyond basic chatbot adoption and address gaps in skills, data and organisational readiness to capture the opportunity, according to Synnex (Thailand) and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
title_cn: Synnex与AWS看好泰国AI产业1.2万亿泰铢商机
summary_cn: 泰国人工智能产业可望产生1.2万亿泰铢经济价值，但企业需要超越基础聊天机器人应用，克服人才、数据和组织就绪度差距才能把握机会。Synnex泰国公司和亚马逊云服务（AWS）指出泰国AI创新潜力巨大，但需要系统性投资和准备。
desc_original: Thailand could unlock up to 1.2 trillion baht in economic impact from artificial intelligence (AI) innovation, but businesses need to move beyond basic chatbot adoption and address gaps in skills, data and organisational readiness to capture the opportunity, according to Synnex (Thailand) and Amazon Web Services (AWS).

title: Protein milk bucks flat dairy market as Dutch Mill expands
desc: While Thailand's dairy market is expected to remain flat this year, the protein-fortified milk segment shows potential for growth, according to Dutch Mill Co Ltd.
title_cn: 蛋白强化奶打破市场困局 Dutch Mill乳业扩张增长
summary_cn: 泰国乳制品市场今年整体预计保持停滞增长，但高蛋白强化奶制品这一细分市场展现出增长潜力和商机。Dutch Mill公司看好此市场机会并计划扩张业务规模，通过产品创新来迎合消费者对健康乳制品的需求，这代表传统乳制品市场中的一个增长亮点。
desc_original: While Thailand's dairy market is expected to remain flat this year, the protein-fortified milk segment shows potential for growth, according to Dutch Mill Co Ltd.

title: "หน่วยเฉพาะกิจนราธิวาส" ยันไม่มีนายทหารยศ "จ่า" บน ฮ. ยิงวัยรุ่นในพื้นที่ อ.จะแนะ
desc: "หน่วยเฉพาะกิจนราธิวาส" ออกแถลงการณ์ แจงข้อเท็จจริงกรณี "ฮ." ในพื้นที่ อ.จะแนะ ยันกำลังพลขึ้นปฏิบัติหน้าที่บนอากาศยาน 4 นาย ไม่มีทหารยศ "จ่า" และไม่มีใครนำอาวุธประจำกายขึ้นไปด้วย
title_cn: 那拉提瓦（Narathiwat）特别任务部队澄清：直升机事件中无中士且未携带武器
summary_cn: 那拉提瓦特别任务部队针对该地区直升机事件发表澄清声明。声明称，执行空中任务的4名军事人员中没有中士身份的军人，也确认没有任何人携带个人武器上直升机执行任务。这是针对相关安全事件的官方澄清回应，旨在消除公众疑虑。

title: จี้รัฐรื้อภาษี เหตุรถผลิตไทยกำลังแพ้ EV นำเข้าครองตลาด 62.58% ปิกอัพทรุดกว่า 60%
desc: ยอดขายรถยนต์ไทย 7 เดือนแรกโต 15.39% แต่เบื้องหลังพบรถยนต์ไฟฟ้านำเข้าครองสัดส่วนถึง 62.58% ของยอดขาย EV ขณะที่รถผลิตในประเทศมีเพียง 37.42%
title_cn: 促请政府撤销税收 泰国产车陷困局 进口电动车占市场62%
summary_cn: 泰国汽车销售前7个月增长15.39%，但进口电动车在电动车市场占62.58%的销售份额，国产电动车仅占37.42%。业界指出泰国产电动车在市场竞争中失利，并呼吁政府调整税收政策以支持国内电动车产业。数据同时反映皮卡市场也面临超60%的销量下滑。
desc_original: ยอดขายรถยนต์ไทย 7 เดือนแรกโต 15.39% แต่เบื้องหลังพบรถยนต์ไฟฟ้านำเข้าครองสัดส่วนถึง 62.58% ของยอดขาย EV ขณะที่รถผลิตในประเทศมีเพียง 37.42%

desc: พรรคประชาชน ขนแกนนำตัวท็อป “พิธา-เท้ง ณัฐพงษ์-ปิยบุตร-ธนาธร” ช่วย “เดชรัต” หาเสียง อบจ.นนทบุรี ตลอดสัปดาห์นี้ มุ่งสู่เป้าหมายการสร้าง “NEW นนท์”
title_cn: 民众党（Pheu Thai）动员党魁协力 力挺德查拉竞选暖武里（Nonthaburi）府长
summary_cn: 民众党动员党内首脑皮塔（Pita）、邓纳通（Theng Nattapong）、皮亚布特（Piyabutr）、他那多恩（Thanathorn）等党魁本周协力为暖武里府长候选人德查拉（Dechrat）进行竞选宣传。该党致力于实现「新暖武里」（New Nonthaburi）的愿景，推动地方治理创新。
